fails_if: the SOS reader stops declaring every workbook variable sensitive, reads a delivered blank Kopplingsvariabel as an unknown identifier claim, or drops the claimed cell from the record's delivered cells
note: Disclosure guard: SOS health and social-services microdata is sensitive whatever the workbook says. A blank Kopplingsvariabel is an explicit false identifier claim, a marker an explicit true one, and each claim stays traceable to its delivered cell. That such flags form without unresolved_flag is the build case formation-sensitivity-ratchets-up-and-unknown-flags-withhold-the-variable (s1c0).
